lines.text: So, Gustaf. How did you build this app?
He built it by talking to AI. A hundred and twenty chats.
lines.caption: He built it by talking to AI. 120 chats.

lines.text: One of them has the answer. He doesn't know which.
I do. I'm Apprentice. I was there.
I read the agent logs on his Mac, and remember how each project was built.
lines.hl: remember how each project was built

lines.text: When he corrects an agent twice, it becomes a rule. Nobody asked him.
Then I call him, and ask.
Tell me about Hack Nation. What do you remember?
And every agent he uses gets the same memory. Before one breaks his rules, it is stopped. In his own words.
lines.hl: the same memory|it is stopped|In his own words.

lines.text: Apprentice. Learning by doing, without the forgetting.
